description: Implementation of SpdyHttpStream class handling SPDY protocol streams, including request/response management, header validation, data transfer, and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: SpdyHttpStream
classes.description: Handles SPDY protocol stream operations including request/response lifecycle, data transfer, and stream management.

methods.name: ValidatePushedHeaders
methods.description: Validates headers for server push responses, ensuring ranges and Vary headers match expectations.

methods.name: SpdyHttpStream::InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the SPDY stream, possibly using a pushed stream if available.

methods.name: SpdyHttpStream::SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over the SPDY stream, handling headers and request body.

methods.name: SpdyHttpStream::OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Processes received response headers, including validation and updating response info.

methods.name: SpdyHttpStream::OnDataReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming data frames for the stream.

methods.description: Handles stream closure, cleaning up state and invoking callbacks.
